name: Sheng Yuan Holdings Limited
summary: Sheng Yuan Holdings Limited, established in 1998 and based in Central, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company providing financial services in Hong Kong and mainland China to professional and retail investors. Its segments are securities brokerage and financial services, asset management, proprietary trading and general trading. Offerings include securities and futures dealing, placement and underwriting, margin financing and money lending, corporate finance advice, fund and portfolio management, and commodity trading in chemicals, energy and minerals.
